dedupe_keys.name: region wide multi year crop field boundary labels for africa 2017 2023 lacuna fund

description: This dataset holds crop field boundary labels across Africa for the years 2017 to 2023, digitised on satellite imagery. The Zenodo record says the project was funded by the Lacuna Fund and led by Farmerline, with Spatial Collective and the Agricultural Impacts Research Group at Clark University, and that a technical report on methods, label quality and usage is in an accompanying repository. It was published in April 2024 (version 1.0.0) as a GeoParquet file of mapped fields (about 84 MB) and an image archive of about 9.9 GB, free to download but under the Planet NICFI participant licence agreement, which governs use of the imagery chips. Coverage is Africa. Caveats: labels are samples, not wall-to-wall maps, and the imagery licence restricts reuse. For simulation it gives training labels to map fields for agricultural exposure and loss estimation in data-poor African regions. Related catalogue records include the Radiant Earth African crop type reference data and MozFields.
